general_information.title: Eisenmenger Syndrome
details: Management and treatment options for patients with Eisenmenger syndrome are discussed including the use of oral sildenafil as a treatment approach.
Studies on the combination therapy of bosentan and sildenafil have been mentioned for patients with Eisenmenger syndrome.

general_information.title: Coronary Anomalies
details: The anomaly of coronary arteries originating from the opposite sinus of Valsalva is discussed.
Various studies exploring the surgical management of these anomalies are mentioned.

genes.context: BMPR2 mutations associated with complex congenital heart disease.
